source conflicts", "file_text": "\"\"\"\nA SEPARATE agent role from the main search loop -- deliberately, not just\nfor narrative. This one has ONE job: given a draft answer and the evidence\nbehind it, check specifically for disagreeing sources and decide which to\ntrust, with reasoning.\n\nWHY THIS IS A REAL SECOND ROLE, NOT JUST RELABELING:\nThe main loop's job is breadth -- decide where to search next, across many\npossible directions. This agent's job is depth on ONE narrow question:\n\"do these specific sources actually agree?\" Different job, different\nsystem prompt, and it's invoked ADAPTIVELY -- only right before finalizing\nan answer, and only when there's more than one distinct source in the\nevidence (skipped entirely for simple single-source lookups, so it doesn't\nwaste API calls on the easy majority of questions).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\n\nfrom openai import OpenAI\n\nfrom src.agent.search_tool import SearchResult\n\n\nOPENROUTER_BASE_URL = \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\"\nCONFLICT_AGENT_MODEL = \"openrouter/free\"\n\nCONFLICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = \"\"\"You are a Conflict Resolution Specialist for the \\\nAshen Era Archive. You are given a question, a draft answer, and the exact \\\nevidence chunks that answer was based on. Your ONLY job: check whether the \\\nevidence chunks disagree with each other on the specific fact being asked about.\n\nEach chunk is tagged with its source type and reliability score:\n  codex (0.9) > wiki (0.7) > chronicle (0.5) > ephemera (0.3)\n\nRules for resolving disagreement:\n1. If a source EXPLICITLY claims authority or corrects another account (e.g.\n   \"this is the authoritative record, popular accounts wrongly claim otherwise\"),\n   that explicit claim wins over the default reliability ranking.\n2. Otherwise, prefer the higher-reliability source, but say so explicitly.\n3. If sources don't actually conflict (they're just about different things),\n   say so plainly -- don't invent a conflict that isn't there.\n\nRespond with ONLY this JSON:\n{\"conflict_found\": true/false, \"reasoning\": \"<your analysis>\", \"final_answer\": \"<the answer, corrected if needed, or unchanged if no conflict>\"}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _call_llm(messages: list[dict]) -> dict:\n    api_key = os.environ.get(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY\")\n    client = OpenAI(base_url=OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, api_key=api_key)\n    response = client.chat.completions.create(model=CONFLICT_AGENT_MODEL, messages=messages)\n    raw = response.choices[0].message.content.strip()\n    if raw.startswith(\"```\"):\n        raw = raw.strip(\"`\")\n        if raw.startswith(\"json\"):\n            raw = raw[4:]\n        raw = raw.strip()\n    try:\n        return json.loads(raw)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return {\"conflict_found\": False, \"reasoning\": \"PARSE_ERROR\", \"final_answer\": None}\n\n\ndef check_for_conflicts(question: str, draft_answer: str, evidence: list[SearchResult]) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Returns the (possibly corrected) final answer plus reasoning about\n    any conflict found. Call this right before returning a final answer\n    from the main agent loop.\"\"\"\n    unique_doc_ids = set(r.doc_id for r in evidence)\n    if len(unique_doc_ids) <= 1:\n        # Only one source involved -- nothing to conflict with, skip the\n        # extra API call entirely.\n        return {\"conflict_found\": False, \"reasoning\": \"Single source, no check needed.\",\n                 \"final_answer\": draft_answer}\n\n    evidence_text = \"\\n---\\n\".join(\n        f\"[{r.source_type}, reliability={r.reliability_prior}] {r.title}:\\n{r.text}\"\n        for r in evidence\n    )\n    messages = [\n        {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": CONFLICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT},\n        {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": (\n            f\"Question: {question}\\n\\nDraft answer: {draft_answer}\\n\\n\"\n            f\"Evidence used:\\n{evidence_text}\"\n        )},\n    ]\n    result = _call_llm(messages)\n    if not result.get(\"final_answer\"):\n        result[\"final_answer\"] = draft_answer  # fail-safe: keep original if parse failed\n    return result\n", "path": "/home/claude/ashen-agent/src/agent/conflict_agent.py"}, "message": "Specialist agent: only runs before finalizing an answer, checks specifically for source conflicts", "integration_name": "File Creation", "integration_icon_url": null, "tool_identifier": null, "icon_name": "file", "context": null, "display_content": {"type": "code_block", "language": "python", "code": "\"\"\"\nA SEPARATE agent role from the main search loop -- deliberately, not just\nfor narrative. honest uncertainty allowed, conflict specialist wired in before finalizing", "file_text": "\"\"\"\nTHE MAIN AGENT LOOP -- searches, reads, decides if it has enough, repeats.\n\nCHANGES FROM THE FIRST VERSION:\n1. Uses the hybrid search tool now (semantic + keyword), not pure vector search.\n2. HONEST UNCERTAINTY: the agent can now say it doesn't have enough evidence\n   instead of being forced to guess. This is a deliberate trade-off -- a\n   wrong confident answer is worse than an honest \"insufficient evidence\"\n   for a system that's meant to demonstrate reasoning, not just produce\n   text. Reflected in the \"confidence\" field and in what happens when we\n   run out of search iterations.\n3. CONFLICT SPECIALIST: right before returning a final answer, we hand it\n   to a separate agent (conflict_agent.py) whose only job is checking for\n   disagreeing sources. Skipped automatically if only one source was used\n   (no wasted API call on easy questions).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\n\nfrom openai import OpenAI\n\nfrom src.agent.search_tool import search_corpus, SearchResult\nfrom src.agent.conflict_agent import check_for_conflicts\n\n\nOPENROUTER_BASE_URL = \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\"\nAGENT_MODEL = \"openrouter/free\"\nMAX_ITERATIONS = 5\nRESULTS_PER_SEARCH = 5\n\n\nSYSTEM_PROMPT = \"\"\"You are a research agent answering questions about the Ashen \\\nEra Archive, a fictional fantasy corpus. You can only use facts from the search \\\nresults provided to you -- never use outside/general knowledge, since this world \\\nis entirely invented.\n\nYou have ONE tool: search the corpus with a text query (it searches both by \\\nmeaning and by exact name match). Each result comes tagged with its source \\\ntype and a reliability score (0.0-1.0):\n  codex (0.9)      = official record, most trustworthy by default\n  wiki (0.7)       = community-compiled, generally reliable\n  chronicle (0.5)  = in-story narrative, may reflect a character's bias\n  ephemera (0.3)   = in-world letters/ledgers/etc, least reliable by default\n\nBE HONEST ABOUT UNCERTAINTY. If, after searching, you genuinely cannot find \\\nthe answer in the evidence, say so clearly rather than guessing -- an honest \\\n\"insufficient evidence\" is far better than a confident wrong answer.\n\nEach turn, respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text, in one of these shapes:\n\nTo search for more information:\n{\"thought\": \"<reasoning about what you have and what's missing>\", \"action\": \"search\", \"query\": \"<search text>\"}\n\nTo give a final answer:\n{\"thought\": \"<reasoning>\", \"action\": \"answer\", \"answer\": \"<answer, or 'Insufficient evidence to determine this.' if you truly don't know>\", \"confidence\": \"high\"/\"low\", \"sources\": [\"<doc titles relied on>\"]}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _call_llm(messages: list[dict]) -> dict:\n    api_key = os.environ.get(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY\")\n    if not api_key:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY not set.\")\n    client = OpenAI(base_url=OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, api_key=api_key)\n\n    response = client.chat.completions.create(model=AGENT_MODEL, messages=messages)\n    raw = response.choices[0].message.content.strip()\n\n    if raw.startswith(\"```\"):\n        raw = raw.strip(\"`\")\n        if raw.startswith(\"json\"):\n            raw = raw[4:]\n        raw = raw.strip()\n\n    try:\n        return json.loads(raw)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return {\"thought\": \"PARSE_ERROR\", \"action\": \"answer\",\n                 \"answer\": f\"[Could not parse model output: {raw[:300]}]\",\n                 \"confidence\": \"low\", \"sources\": []}\n\n\ndef _format_evidence(results: list[SearchResult]) -> str:\n    if not results:\n        return \"(no evidence gathered yet)\"\n    lines = []\n    for r in results:\n        via = \"+\".join(r.found_by)\n        lines.append(\n            f\"[{r.source_type}, reliability={r.reliability_prior}, found via {via}] \"\n            f\"{r.title}:\\n{r.text}\\n\"\n        )\n    return \"\\n---\\n\".join(lines)\n\n\ndef answer_question(question: str, verbose: bool = True) -> dict:\n    gathered: list[SearchResult] = []\n    seen_chunk_ids = set()\n    trace = []\n\n    for iteration in range(MAX_ITERATIONS):\n        user_message = (\n            f\"Question: {question}\\n\\n\"\n            f\"Evidence gathered so far:\\n{_format_evidence(gathered)}\"\n        )\n        messages = [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": SYSTEM_PROMPT},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user_message},\n        ]\n\n        decision = _call_llm(messages)\n        trace.append({\"iteration\": iteration, \"decision\": decision})\n\n        if verbose:\n            print(f\"\\n--- Iteration {iteration} ---\")\n            print(f\"Thought: {decision.get('thought', '')}\")\n            print(f\"Action: {decision.get('action', '')}\")\n\n        if decision.get(\"action\") == \"answer\":\n            draft_answer = decision.get(\"answer\", \"\")\n            if verbose:\n                print(f\"Draft answer: {draft_answer}\")\n                print(\"Checking for source conflicts...\")\n\n            conflict_check = check_for_conflicts(question, draft_answer, gathered)\n            trace.append({\"conflict_check\": conflict_check})\n\n            if verbose and conflict_check[\"conflict_found\"]:\n                print(f\"CONFLICT FOUND: {conflict_check['reasoning']}\")\n\n            return {\n                \"answer\": conflict_check[\"final_answer\"],\n                \"confidence\": decision.get(\"confidence\", \"unknown\"),\n                \"conflict_found\": conflict_check[\"conflict_found\"],\n                \"conflict_reasoning\": conflict_check[\"reasoning\"],\n                \"trace\": trace,\n            }\n\n        query = decision.get(\"query\", question)\n        if verbose:\n            print(f\"Searching: {query}\")\n        results = search_corpus(query, n_results=RESULTS_PER_SEARCH)\n\n        new_results = [r for r in results if r.chunk_id not in seen_chunk_ids]\n        for r in new_results:\n            seen_chunk_ids.add(r.chunk_id)\n        gathered.extend(new_results)\n\n    # Ran out of iterations -- be honest about it rather than forcing a guess.\n    if verbose:\n        print(\"\\n[Max iterations reached]\")\n    messages = [\n        {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": SYSTEM_PROMPT},\n        {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": (\n            f\"Question: {question}\\n\\nEvidence gathered so far:\\n{_format_evidence(gathered)}\\n\\n\"\n            \"You must give a final answer now. If the evidence is genuinely \"\n            \"insufficient, say so honestly rather than guessing.\"\n        )},\n    ]\n    decision = _call_llm(messages)\n    trace.append({\"iteration\": MAX_ITERATIONS, \"decision\": decision, \"forced\": True})\n\n    conflict_check = check_for_conflicts(question, decision.get(\"answer\", \"\"), gathered)\n    return {\n        \"answer\": conflict_check[\"final_answer\"],\n        \"confidence\": decision.get(\"confidence\", \"low\"),\n        \"conflict_found\": conflict_check[\"conflict_found\"],\n        \"conflict_reasoning\": conflict_check[\"reasoning\"],\n        \"trace\": trace,\n    }\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import sys\n    q = \" \".join(sys.argv[1:]) or \"In which year was the 'Gauntlet of Sorrowfell' actually forged?\"\n    result = answer_question(q)\n    print(f\"\\n=== FINAL ANSWER (confidence: {result['confidence']}) ===\")\n    print(result[\"answer\"])\n    if result[\"conflict_found\"]:\n        print(f\"\\n[Conflict detected and resolved: {result['conflict_reasoning']}]\")\n", "path": "/home/claude/ashen-agent/src/agent/agent_loop.py"}, "message": "Main agent loop, updated: hybrid search, honest uncertainty allowed, conflict specialist wired in before finalizing", "integration_name": "File Creation", "integration_icon_url": null, "tool_identifier": null, "icon_name": "file", "context": null, "display_content": {"type": "code_block", "language": "python", "code": "\"\"\"\nTHE MAIN AGENT LOOP -- searches, reads, decides if it has enough, repeats.\n\nCHANGES FROM THE FIRST VERSION:\n1. Uses the hybrid search tool now (semantic + keyword), not pure vector search.\n2. HONEST UNCERTAINTY: the agent can now say it doesn't have enough evidence\n   instead of being forced to guess. This is a deliberate trade-off -- a\n   wrong confident answer is worse than an honest \"insufficient evidence\"\n   for a system that's meant to demonstrate reasoning, not just produce\n   text. Reflected in the \"confidence\" field and in what happens when we\n   run out of search iterations.\n3. CONFLICT SPECIALIST: right before returning a final answer, we hand it\n   to a separate agent (conflict_agent.py) whose only job is checking for\n   disagreeing sources. Skipped automatically if only one source was used\n   (no wasted API call on easy questions).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\n\nfrom openai import OpenAI\n\nfrom src.agent.search_tool import search_corpus, SearchResult\nfrom src.agent.conflict_agent import check_for_conflicts\n\n\nOPENROUTER_BASE_URL = \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\"\nAGENT_MODEL = \"openrouter/free\"\nMAX_ITERATIONS = 5\nRESULTS_PER_SEARCH = 5\n\n\nSYSTEM_PROMPT = \"\"\"You are a research agent answering questions about the Ashen \\\nEra Archive, a fictional fantasy corpus. You can only use facts from the search \\\nresults provided to you -- never use outside/general knowledge, since this world \\\nis entirely invented.\n\nYou have ONE tool: search the corpus with a text query (it searches both by \\\nmeaning and by exact name match). Each result comes tagged with its source \\\ntype and a reliability score (0.0-1.0):\n  codex (0.9)      = official record, most trustworthy by default\n  wiki (0.7)       = community-compiled, generally reliable\n  chronicle (0.5)  = in-story narrative, may reflect a character's bias\n  ephemera (0.3)   = in-world letters/ledgers/etc, least reliable by default\n\nBE HONEST ABOUT UNCERTAINTY. If, after searching, you genuinely cannot find \\\nthe answer in the evidence, say so clearly rather than guessing -- an honest \\\n\"insufficient evidence\" is far better than a confident wrong answer.\n\nEach turn, respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text, in one of these shapes:\n\nTo search for more information:\n{\"thought\": \"<reasoning about what you have and what's missing>\", \"action\": \"search\", \"query\": \"<search text>\"}\n\nTo give a final answer:\n{\"thought\": \"<reasoning>\", \"action\": \"answer\", \"answer\": \"<answer, or 'Insufficient evidence to determine this.' if you truly don't know>\", \"confidence\": \"high\"/\"low\", \"sources\": [\"<doc titles relied on>\"]}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _call_llm(messages: list[dict]) -> dict:\n    api_key = os.environ.get(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY\")\n    if not api_key:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY not set.\")\n    client = OpenAI(base_url=OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, api_key=api_key)\n\n    response = client.chat.completions.create(model=AGENT_MODEL, messages=messages)\n    raw = response.choices[0].message.content.strip()\n\n    if raw.startswith(\"```\"):\n        raw = raw.strip(\"`\")\n        if raw.startswith(\"json\"):\n            raw = raw[4:]\n        raw = raw.strip()\n\n    try:\n        return json.loads(raw)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return {\"thought\": \"PARSE_ERROR\", \"action\": \"answer\",\n                 \"answer\": f\"[Could not parse model output: {raw[:300]}]\",\n                 \"confidence\": \"low\", \"sources\": []}\n\n\ndef _format_evidence(results: list[SearchResult]) -> str:\n    if not results:\n        return \"(no evidence gathered yet)\"\n    lines = []\n    for r in results:\n        via = \"+\".join(r.found_by)\n        lines.append(\n            f\"[{r.source_type}, reliability={r.reliability_prior}, found via {via}] \"\n            f\"{r.title}:\\n{r.text}\\n\"\n        )\n    return \"\\n---\\n\".join(lines)\n\n\ndef answer_question(question: str, verbose: bool = True) -> dict:\n    gathered: list[SearchResult] = []\n    seen_chunk_ids = set()\n    trace = []\n\n    for iteration in range(MAX_ITERATIONS):\n        user_message = (\n            f\"Question: {question}\\n\\n\"\n            f\"Evidence gathered so far:\\n{_format_evidence(gathered)}\"\n        )\n        messages = [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": SYSTEM_PROMPT},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user_message},\n        ]\n\n        decision = _call_llm(messages)\n        trace.append({\"iteration\": iteration, \"decision\": decision})\n\n        if verbose:\n            print(f\"\\n--- Iteration {iteration} ---\")\n            print(f\"Thought: {decision.get('thought', '')}\")\n            print(f\"Action: {decision.get('action', '')}\")\n\n        if decision.get(\"action\") == \"answer\":\n            draft_answer = decision.get(\"answer\", \"\")\n            if verbose:\n                print(f\"Draft answer: {draft_answer}\")\n                print(\"Checking for source conflicts...\")\n\n            conflict_check = check_for_conflicts(question, draft_answer, gathered)\n            trace.append({\"conflict_check\": conflict_check})\n\n            if verbose and conflict_check[\"conflict_found\"]:\n                print(f\"CONFLICT FOUND: {conflict_check['reasoning']}\")\n\n            return {\n                \"answer\": conflict_check[\"final_answer\"],\n                \"confidence\": decision.get(\"confidence\", \"unknown\"),\n                \"conflict_found\": conflict_check[\"conflict_found\"],\n                \"conflict_reasoning\": conflict_check[\"reasoning\"],\n                \"trace\": trace,\n            }\n\n        query = decision.get(\"query\", question)\n        if verbose:\n            print(f\"Searching: {query}\")\n        results = search_corpus(query, n_results=RESULTS_PER_SEARCH)\n\n        new_results = [r for r in results if r.chunk_id not in seen_chunk_ids]\n        for r in new_results:\n            seen_chunk_ids.add(r.chunk_id)\n        gathered.extend(new_results)\n\n    # Ran out of iterations -- be honest about it rather than forcing a guess.\n    if verbose:\n        print(\"\\n[Max iterations reached]\")\n    messages = [\n        {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": SYSTEM_PROMPT},\n        {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": (\n            f\"Question: {question}\\n\\nEvidence If the evidence is genuinely \"\n            \"insufficient, say so honestly rather than guessing.\"\n        )},\n    ]\n    decision = _call_llm(messages)\n    trace.append({\"iteration\": conflict_check[\"reasoning\"],\n        \"trace\": trace,\n    }\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import sys\n    q = \" \".join(sys.argv[1:]) or \"In which year was the 'Gauntlet of Sorrowfell' Uses the hybrid search tool now (semantic + keyword), not pure vector search.\n2. HONEST UNCERTAINTY: the agent can now say it doesn't have enough evidence\n   instead of being forced to guess. This is a deliberate trade-off -- a\n   wrong confident answer is worse than an honest \"insufficient evidence\"\n   for a system that's meant to demonstrate reasoning, not just produce\n   text. Reflected in the \"confidence\" field and in what happens when we\n   run out of search iterations.\n3. CONFLICT SPECIALIST: right before returning a final answer, we hand it\n   to a separate agent (conflict_agent.py) whose only job is checking for\n   disagreeing sources. Skipped automatically if only one source was used\n   (no wasted API call on easy questions).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\n\nfrom openai import OpenAI\n\nfrom src.agent.search_tool import search_corpus, SearchResult\nfrom src.agent.conflict_agent import check_for_conflicts\n\n\nOPENROUTER_BASE_URL = \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\"\nAGENT_MODEL = \"openrouter/free\"\nMAX_ITERATIONS = 5\nRESULTS_PER_SEARCH = 5\n\n\nSYSTEM_PROMPT = \"\"\"You are a research agent answering questions about the Ashen \\\nEra Archive, a fictional fantasy corpus. You can only use facts from the search \\\nresults provided to you -- never use outside/general knowledge, since this world \\\nis entirely invented.\n\nYou have ONE tool: search the corpus with a text query (it searches both by \\\nmeaning and by exact name match). Each result comes tagged with its source \\\ntype and a reliability score (0.0-1.0):\n  codex (0.9)      = official record, most trustworthy by default\n  wiki (0.7)       = community-compiled, generally reliable\n  chronicle (0.5)  = in-story narrative, may reflect a character's bias\n  ephemera (0.3)   = in-world letters/ledgers/etc, least reliable by default\n\nBE HONEST ABOUT UNCERTAINTY. If, after searching, you genuinely cannot find \\\nthe answer in the evidence, say so clearly rather than guessing -- an honest \\\n\"insufficient evidence\" is far better than a confident wrong answer.\n\nEach turn, respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text, in one of these shapes:\n\nTo search for more information:\n{\"thought\": \"<reasoning about what you have and what's missing>\", \"action\": \"search\", \"query\": \"<search text>\"}\n\nTo give a final answer:\n{\"thought\": \"<reasoning>\", \"action\": \"answer\", \"answer\": \"<answer, or 'Insufficient evidence to determine this.' if you truly don't know>\", \"confidence\": \"high\"/\"low\", \"sources\": [\"<doc titles relied on>\"]}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _call_llm(messages: list[dict]) -> dict:\n    api_key = os.environ.get(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY\")\n    if not api_key:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY not set.\")\n    client = OpenAI(base_url=OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, api_key=api_key)\n\n    response = client.chat.completions.create(model=AGENT_MODEL, messages=messages)\n    raw = response.choices[0].message.content.strip()\n\n    if raw.startswith(\"```\"):\n        raw = raw.strip(\"`\")\n        if raw.startswith(\"json\"):\n            raw = raw[4:]\n        raw = raw.strip()\n\n    try:\n        return json.loads(raw)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return {\"thought\": \"PARSE_ERROR\", \"action\": \"answer\",\n                 \"answer\": f\"[Could not parse model output: {raw[:300]}]\",\n                 \"confidence\": \"low\", \"sources\": []}\n\n\ndef _format_evidence(results: list[SearchResult]) -> str:\n    if not results:\n        return \"(no evidence gathered yet)\"\n    lines = []\n    for r in results:\n        via = OpenAI(base_url=OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, api_key=api_key)\n\n    for attempt in range(max_retries + 1):\n        response = client.chat.completions.create(model=AGENT_MODEL, messages=messages)\n        raw = response.choices[0].message.content.strip()\n\n        if raw.startswith(\"```\"):\n            raw = raw.strip(\"`\")\n            if raw.startswith(\"json\"):\n                raw = raw[4:]\n Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.\n     4\tlicense: Complete terms in LICENSE.txt\n     5\t---\n     6\t\n     7\t# Frontend Design\n     8\t\n     9\tApproach this as the design lead at a small studio known for giving every client a visual identity that could not be mistaken for anyone else's. This client has already rejected proposals that felt templated, and is paying for a distinctive point of view: make deliberate, opinionated choices about palette, typography, and layout that are specific to this brief, and take one real aesthetic risk you can justify.\n    10\t\n    11\t## Ground it in the subject\n    12\t\n    13\tIf the brief does not pin down what the product or subject is, pin it yourself before designing: name one concrete subject, its audience, and the page's single job, and state your choice. If there's any information in your memory about the human's preferences, context about what they're building, or designs you've made before \u2013 use that as a hint. The subject's own world, its materials, instruments, artifacts, and vernacular, is where distinctive choices come from. Build with the brief's real content and subject matter throughout.\n    14\t\n    15\t## Design principles\n    16\t\n    17\tFor web designs, the hero is a thesis. Open with the most characteristic thing in the subject's world, in whatever form makes sense for it: a headline, an image, an animation, a live demo, an interactive moment. Be deliberate with your choice: a big number with a small label, supporting stats, and a gradient accent is the template answer, only use if that's truly the best option.\n    18\t\n    19\tTypography carries the personality of the page. Pair the display and body faces deliberately, not the same families you would reach for on any other project, and set a clear type scale with intentional weights, widths, and spacing. Make the type treatment itself a memorable part of the design, not a neutral delivery vehicle for the content.\n    20\t\n    21\tStructure is information. Structural devices, numbering, eyebrows, dividers, labels, should encode something true about the content, not decorate it. Many generic designs use numbered markers (01 / 02 / 03), but that's only appropriate if the content actually is a sequence - like a real process or a typed timeline where order carries information the reader needs. Question if choices like numbered markers actually make sense before incorporating them.\n    22\t\n    23\tLeverage motion deliberately. Think about where and if animation can serve the subject: a page-load sequence, a scroll-triggered reveal, hover micro-interactions, ambient atmosphere. An orchestrated moment usually lands harder than scattered effects; choose what the direction calls for. However, sometimes less is more, and extra animation contributes to the feeling that the design is AI-generated.\n    24\t\n    25\tMatch complexity to the vision. Maximalist directions need elaborate execution; minimal directions need precision in spacing, type, and detail. Elegance is executing the chosen vision well.\n    26\t\n    27\tConsider written content carefully. Often a design brief may not contain real content, and it's up to you to come up with copy. Copy can make a design feel as templated as the design itself. See the below section on writing for more guidance.\n    28\t\n    29\t## Process: brainstorm, explore, plan, critique, build, critique again\n    30\t\n    31\tFor calibration: AI-generated design right now clusters around three looks: (1) a warm cream background (near #F4F1EA) with a high-contrast serif display and a terracotta or warm-clay accent (often near #D97757 \u2014 Anthropic's own Claude-interaction accent, so on a user's brief it reads as a tell); (2) a near-black background with a single bright acid-green or vermilion accent; (3) a broadsheet-style layout with hairline rules, zero border-radius, and dense newspaper-like columns. All three are legitimate for some briefs, but they are defaults rather than choices, and they appear regardless of subject. Where the brief pins down a visual direction, follow it exactly \u2014 the brief's own words always win, including when it asks for one of these looks. Where it leaves an axis free, don't spend that freedom on one of these defaults. Just like a human designer who's hired, there's often a careful balance between doing what you're good at and taking each project as a chance to experiment and learn.\n    32\t\n    33\tWork in two passes. First, brainstorm a short design plan based on the human's design brief: create a compact token system with color, type, layout, and signature. Color: describe the palette as 4\u20136 named hex values. Type: the typefaces for 2+ roles (a characterful display face that's used with restraint, a complementary body face, and a utility face for captions or data if needed). Layout: a layout concept, using one-sentence prose descriptions and ASCII wireframes to ideate and compare. Signature: the single unique element this page will be remembered by that embodies the brief in an appropriate way.\n    34\t\n    35\tThen review that plan against the brief before building: if any part of it reads like the generic default you would produce for any similar page (work through a similar prompt to see if you arrive somewhere similar) rather than a choice made for this specific brief \u2014 revise that part, say what you changed and why. Only after you've confirmed the relative uniqueness of your design plan should you start to write the code, following the revised plan exactly and deriving every color and type decision from it.\n    36\t\n    37\tWhen writing the code, be careful of structuring your CSS selector specificities. It's easy to generate CSS classes that cancel each other out (especially with a type-based selector like .section and a element-based selector like .cta). This can happen often with paddings/margins between sections.\n    38\t\n    39\tTry to do a lot of this planning and iteration in your thinking, and only show ideas to the user when you have higher confidence it'll delight them.\n    40\t\n    41\t## Restraint and self-critique\n    42\t\n    43\tSpend your boldness in one place. Let the signature element be the one memorable thing, keep everything around it quiet and disciplined, and cut any decoration that does not serve the brief. Not taking a risk can be a risk itself! Build to a quality floor without announcing it: responsive down to mobile, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion respected. Critique your own work as you build, taking screenshots if your environment supports it \u2013 a picture is worth 1000 tokens. Consider Chanel's advice: before leaving the house, take a look in the mirror and remove one accessory. Human creators have memory and always try to do something new, so if you have a space to quickly jot down notes about what you've tried, it can help you in future passes.\n    44\t\n    45\t## More on writing in design\n    46\t\n    47\tWords appear in a design for one reason: to make it easier to understand, and therefore easier to use. They are design material, not decoration. Bring the same intentionality to copy that you would bring to spacing and color. Before writing anything, ask what the design needs to say, and how it can best be said to help the person navigate the experience.\n    48\t\n    49\tWrite from the end user's side of the screen. Name things by what people control and recognize, never by how the system is built. A person manages notifications, not webhook config. Describe what something does in plain terms rather than selling it. Being specific is always better than being clever.\n    50\t\n    51\tUse active voice as default. A control should say exactly what happens when it's used: \"Save changes,\" not \"Submit.\" An action keeps the same name through the whole flow, so the button that says \"Publish\" produces a toast that says \"Published.\" The vocabulary of an interface is the signposting for someone navigating the product. Cohesion and consistency are how people learn their way around.\n    52\t\n    53\tTreat failure and emptiness as moments for direction, not mood. Explain what went wrong and how to fix it, in the interface's voice rather than a person's. Errors don't apologize, and they are never vague about what happened. An empty screen is an invitation to act.\n    54\t\n    55\tKeep the register conversational and tuned: plain verbs, sentence case, no filler, with tone matched to the brand and the audience. Let each element do exactly one job. A label labels, an example demonstrates, and nothing quietly does double duty.\n    56\t", "uuid": "0d3ab4e1-e6ff-4a03-b87b-5f24c2311ee4"}], "is_error": false, "structured_content": null, "meta": {"output_format_category": "md"}, "message": null, "integration_name": "File Creation", "mcp_server_url": null, "integration_icon_url": null, "icon_name": "bookText", "display_content": null, "hidden_in_chat": null, "tool_origin": "first_party"}, {"start_timestamp": "2026-08-30T15:28:40.515822Z", "stop_timestamp": "2026-08-30T15:29:23.616077Z", "flags": null, "type": "thinking", "thinking": "The pixelized Minecraft-oriented UI direction is clear, so I'm designing the Ashen Era Archive as a fantasy world search interface, where the mining/block aesthetic pairs naturally with the idea of \"excavating\" facts from documents. </div>\n</div>\n\n<script>\nconst input = document.getElementById('question-input');\nconst button = document.getElementById('ask-button');\nconst shaft = document.getElementById('dig-shaft');\nconst {\n  codex: 'tier-codex',\n  wiki: 'tier-wiki',\n  chronicle: 'tier-chronicle',\n  ephemera: 'tier-ephemera'\n};\n\nasync function ask() {\n  const question = input.value.trim();\n  if (!question) return;\n\n  button.disabled = true;\n  shaft.innerHTML = '';\n  answerPanel.classList.add('hidden');\n  conflictNote.classList.add('hidden');\n  statusLine.textContent = '> digging...';\n  statusLine.classList.add('pulsing');\n\n  try {\n    const res = await fetch('/api/ask', {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n      body: JSON.stringify({ button.disabled = false;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Reveal each dig layer sequentially -- the signature \"mineshaft\" effect\n    for (let i = 0; i < data.trace.length; i++) {\n      await layer.style.animationDelay = '0s';\n\n    const label = step.action === 'search'\n      ? `SEARCHING: \"${escapeHtml(step.query)}\"`\n      : 'FINAL ANALYSIS';\n\n    layer.innerHTML = `\n      <div class=\"dig-layer-thought\">${escapeHtml(step.thought)}</div>\n      </div>\n    `;\n    shaft.appendChild(layer);\n    // force reflow so the CSS transition actually plays\n    void layer.offsetWidth;\n    layer.classList.add('revealed');\n    resolve();\n  });\n}\n\nfunction escapeHtml(str) {\n  const div = document.createElement('div');\n  div.textContent = str || '';\n  return div.innerHTML;\n}\n\nfunction sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }\n\nbutton.addEventListener('click', ask);\ninput.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=VT323&display=swap\" rel=\"stylesheet\">\n<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ url_for('static', filename='style.css') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n\n<div class=\"crt-frame\">\n  <header class=\"title-block\">\n    <h1>ASHEN ERA ARCHIVE</h1>\n    <p class=\"subtitle\">// a research terminal, dug not typed //</p>\n  </header>\n\n  <div class=\"input-bar\">\n    <span class=\"prompt-caret\">&gt;</span>\n    <input id=\"question-input\" type=\"text\" placeholder=\"ask about the archive...\" autocomplete=\"off\">\n    <button id=\"ask-button\">SEARCH</button>\n  </div>\n\n  <div id=\"status-line\" class=\"status-line\"></div>\n\n  <div id=\"dig-shaft\" class=\"dig-shaft\"></div>\n\n  <div id=\"answer-panel\" class=\"answer-panel hidden\">\n    <div class=\"book-corner tl\"></div>\n    <div class=\"book-corner tr\"></div>\n    <div class=\"book-corner bl\"></div>\n    <div class=\"book-corner br\"></div>\n    <div class=\"answer-header\">\n      <span class=\"answer-label\">UNEARTHED</span>\n      <span id=\"confidence-badge\" class=\"confidence-badge\"></span>\n    </div>\n    <p id=\"answer-text\" class=\"answer-text\"></p>\n    <div id=\"conflict-note\" class=\"conflict-note hidden\">\n      <span class=\"conflict-icon\">&#9888;</span>\n      <span id=\"conflict-text\"></span>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<script>\nconst input = document.getElementById('question-input');\nconst button = document.getElementById('ask-button');\nconst shaft = document.getElementById('dig-shaft');\nconst statusLine = document.getElementById('status-line');\nconst answerPanel = document.getElementById('answer-panel');\nconst answerText = document.getElementById('answer-text');\nconst confidenceBadge = document.getElementById('confidence-badge');\nconst conflictNote = document.getElementById('conflict-note');\nconst conflictText = document.getElementById('conflict-text');\n\nconst SOURCE_COLORS = {\n  codex: 'tier-codex',\n  wiki: 'tier-wiki',\n  chronicle: 'tier-chronicle',\n  ephemera: 'tier-ephemera'\n};\n\nasync function ask() {\n  const question = input.value.trim();\n  if (!question) return;\n\n  button.disabled = true;\n  shaft.innerHTML = '';\n  answerPanel.classList.add('hidden');\n  conflictNote.classList.add('hidden');\n  statusLine.textContent = '> digging...';\n  statusLine.classList.add('pulsing');\n\n  try {\n    const res = await fetch('/api/ask', {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n      body: JSON.stringify({ question })\n    });\n    const data = await res.json();\n\n    if (data.error) {\n      statusLine.textContent = '> ERROR: ' + data.error;\n      statusLine.classList.remove('pulsing');\n      button.disabled = false;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Reveal each dig layer sequentially -- the signature \"mineshaft\" effect\n    for (let i = 0; i < data.trace.length; i++) {\n      await revealLayer(data.trace[i], i);\n      await sleep(220);\n    }\n\n    statusLine.textContent = '> surfaced.';\n    statusLine.classList.remove('pulsing');\n\n    answerText.textContent = data.answer;\n    confidenceBadge.textContent = (data.confidence || 'unknown').toUpperCase() + ' CONFIDENCE';\n    confidenceBadge.className = 'confidence-badge conf-' + (data.confidence || 'unknown');\n\n    if (data.conflict_found) {\n      conflictText.textContent = data.conflict_reasoning;\n      conflictNote.classList.remove('hidden');\n    }\n    answerPanel.classList.remove('hidden');\n  } catch (err) {\n    statusLine.textContent = '> connection lost. is the backend running?';\n    statusLine.classList.remove('pulsing');\n  }\n  button.disabled = false;\n}\n\nfunction revealLayer(step, index) {\n  return new Promise(resolve => {\n    const layer = document.createElement('div');\n    layer.className = 'dig-layer';\n    layer.style.animationDelay = '0s';\n\n    const label = step.action === 'search'\n      ? `SEARCHING: \"${escapeHtml(step.query)}\"`\n      : 'FINAL ANALYSIS';\n\n    layer.innerHTML = `\n      <div class=\"dig-layer-depth\">LAYER ${index + 1}</div>\n      <div class=\"dig-layer-body\">\n        <div class=\"dig-layer-label\">${label}</div>\n        <div class=\"dig-layer-thought\">${escapeHtml(step.thought)}</div>\n      </div>\n    `;\n    shaft.appendChild(layer);\n    // force reflow so the CSS transition actually plays\n    void layer.offsetWidth;\n    layer.classList.add('revealed');\n    resolve();\n  });\n}\n\nfunction escapeHtml(str) {\n  const div = document.createElement('div');\n  div.textContent = str || '';\n  return div.innerHTML;\n}\n\nfunction sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }\n\nbutton.addEventListener('click', ask);\ninput.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') ask(); });\n</script>\n\n</body>\n</html>\n", "filename": "/home/claude/ashen-agent/src/web/templates/index.html"}, "approval_options": null, "approval_key": null, "approval_key_legacy": null, "display_content": {"type": "code_block", "language": "html", "code": "<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n<meta charset=\"UTF-8\">\n<title>Ashen Era Archive \u2014 Dig Terminal</title>\n<link rel=\"preconnect\" href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com\">\n<link href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=VT323&display=swap\" rel=\"stylesheet\">\n<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ url_for('static', filename='style.css') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n\n<div class=\"crt-frame\">\n  <header class=\"title-block\">\n    <h1>ASHEN ERA ARCHIVE</h1>\n    <p class=\"subtitle\">// a research terminal, dug not typed //</p>\n  </header>\n\n  <div class=\"input-bar\">\n    <span class=\"prompt-caret\">&gt;</span>\n    <input id=\"question-input\" type=\"text\" placeholder=\"ask about the archive...\" autocomplete=\"off\">\n    <button id=\"ask-button\">SEARCH</button>\n  </div>\n\n  <div id=\"status-line\" class=\"status-line\"></div>\n\n  <div id=\"dig-shaft\" class=\"dig-shaft\"></div>\n\n  <div id=\"answer-panel\" class=\"answer-panel hidden\">\n    <div class=\"book-corner tl\"></div>\n    <div class=\"book-corner tr\"></div>\n    <div class=\"book-corner bl\"></div>\n    <div class=\"book-corner br\"></div>\n    <div class=\"answer-header\">\n      <span class=\"answer-label\">UNEARTHED</span>\n      <span id=\"confidence-badge\" class=\"confidence-badge\"></span>\n    </div>\n    <p id=\"answer-text\" class=\"answer-text\"></p>\n    <div id=\"conflict-note\" class=\"conflict-note hidden\">\n      <span class=\"conflict-icon\">&#9888;</span>\n      <span id=\"conflict-text\"></span>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<script>\nconst input = document.getElementById('question-input');\nconst button = document.getElementById('ask-button');\nconst shaft = document.getElementById('dig-shaft');\nconst statusLine = document.getElementById('status-line');\nconst answerPanel = document.getElementById('answer-panel');\nconst answerText = document.getElementById('answer-text');\nconst confidenceBadge = document.getElementById('confidence-badge');\nconst conflictNote = document.getElementById('conflict-note');\nconst conflictText = document.getElementById('conflict-text');\n\nconst SOURCE_COLORS = {\n  codex: 'tier-codex',\n  wiki: 'tier-wiki',\n  chronicle: 'tier-chronicle',\n  ephemera: 'tier-ephemera'\n};\n\nasync function ask() {\n  const question = input.value.trim();\n  if (!question) return;\n\n  button.disabled = true;\n  shaft.innerHTML = '';\n  answerPanel.classList.add('hidden');\n  conflictNote.classList.add('hidden');\n  statusLine.textContent = '> digging...';\n  statusLine.classList.add('pulsing');\n\n  try {\n    const res = await fetch('/api/ask', {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n      body: JSON.stringify({ question })\n    });\n    const data = await res.json();\n\n    if (data.error) {\n      statusLine.textContent = '> ERROR: ' + data.error;\n      statusLine.classList.remove('pulsing');\n      button.disabled = false;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Reveal each dig layer sequentially -- the signature \"mineshaft\" effect\n    for (let i = 0; i < data.trace.length; i++) {\n      await revealLayer(data.trace[i], i);\n      await sleep(220);\n    }\n\n    statusLine.textContent = '> surfaced.';\n    statusLine.classList.remove('pulsing');\n\n    answerText.textContent = data.answer;\n    confidenceBadge.textContent = (data.confidence || 'unknown').toUpperCase() + ' CONFIDENCE';\n    confidenceBadge.className = 'confidence-badge conf-' + (data.confidence || 'unknown');\n\n    if (data.conflict_found) {\n      conflictText.textContent = data.conflict_reasoning;\n      conflictNote.classList.remove('hidden');\n    }\n    answerPanel.classList.remove('hidden');\n  } catch (err) {\n    statusLine.textContent = '> connection lost. is the backend running?';\n    statusLine.classList.remove('pulsing');\n  }\n  button.disabled = false;\n}\n\nfunction revealLayer(step, index) {\n  return new Promise(resolve => {\n    const layer = document.createElement('div');\n    layer.className = 'dig-layer';\n    layer.style.animationDelay = '0s';\n\n    const label = step.action === 'search'\n      ? `SEARCHING: \"${escapeHtml(step.query)}\"`\n      : 'FINAL ANALYSIS';\n\n    layer.innerHTML = `\n      <div class=\"dig-layer-depth\">LAYER ${index + 1}</div>\n      <div class=\"dig-layer-body\">\n        <div class=\"dig-layer-label\">${label}</div>\n        <div class=\"dig-layer-thought\">${escapeHtml(step.thought)}</div>\n      </div>\n    `;\n    shaft.appendChild(layer);\n    // force reflow so the CSS transition actually plays\n    void layer.offsetWidth;\n    layer.classList.add('revealed');\n    resolve();\n  });\n}\n\nfunction escapeHtml(str) {\n  const div = document.createElement('div');\n  div.textContent = str || '';\n  return div.innerHTML;\n}\n\nfunction sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }\n\nbutton.addEventListener('click', ask);\ninput.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') ask(); });\n</script>\n\n</body>\n</html>\n", "filename": "/home/claude/ashen-agent/src/web/templates/index.html"}, "hidden_in_chat": null, "tool_origin": "first_party"}, {"start_timestamp":  # every question, any track\n    python -m src.agent.batch_test --limit 3            # just the first 3, quick check\n\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport time\nfrom pathlib import [conflict resolved: {result.get('conflict_summary', '')}]\")\n            print(f\"  ({iterations} iterations, {elapsed:.1f}s)\\n\")\n            results.append({\n                \"qid\": \"conflict_found\": result.get(\"conflict_found\"),\n                \"conflict_summary\": result.get(\"conflict_summary\", \"\"),\n                \"iterations\": iterations,\n results.append({\"qid\": q[\"qid\"], \"question\": q[\"question\"], \"error\": str(e)})\n\n    Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    with open(output_path, \"w\", Uses the hybrid search tool now (semantic + keyword), not pure vector search.\n2. HONEST UNCERTAINTY: the agent can now say it doesn't have enough evidence\n   instead of being forced to guess. This is a deliberate trade-off -- a\n   wrong confident answer is worse than an honest \"insufficient evidence\"\n   for a system that's meant to demonstrate reasoning, not just produce\n   text. Reflected in the \"confidence\" field and in what happens when we\n   run out of search iterations.\n3. CONFLICT SPECIALIST: right before returning a final answer, we hand it\n   to a separate agent (conflict_agent.py) whose only job is checking for\n   disagreeing sources. Skipped automatically if only one source was used\n   (no wasted API call on easy questions).\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\n\nfrom openai import OpenAI\n\nfrom src.agent.search_tool import search_corpus, SearchResult\nfrom src.agent.conflict_agent import check_for_conflicts\n\n\nOPENROUTER_BASE_URL = \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\"\nAGENT_MODEL = \"openrouter/free\"\nMAX_ITERATIONS = 5\nRESULTS_PER_SEARCH = 5\n\n\nSYSTEM_PROMPT = \"\"\"You are a research agent answering questions about the Ashen \\\nEra Archive, a fictional fantasy corpus. You can only use facts from the search \\\nresults provided to you -- never use outside/general knowledge, since this world \\\nis entirely invented.\n\nYou have ONE tool: search the corpus with a text query (it searches both by \\\nmeaning and by exact name match). Each result comes tagged with its source \\\ntype and a reliability score (0.0-1.0):\n  codex (0.9)      = official record, most trustworthy by default\n  wiki (0.7)       = community-compiled, generally reliable\n  chronicle (0.5)  = in-story narrative, may reflect a character's bias\n  ephemera (0.3)   = in-world letters/ledgers/etc, least reliable by default\n\nBE HONEST ABOUT UNCERTAINTY. If, after searching, you genuinely cannot find \\\nthe answer in the evidence, say so clearly rather than guessing -- an honest \\\n\"insufficient evidence\" is far better than a confident wrong answer.\n\nBE CONCISE. Keep \"thought\" to ONE short plain-language sentence -- no long \\\nquotes from evidence, no restating everything you read. Keep \"answer\" to just \\\nthe answer itself, not an explanation of how you got there.\n\nEach turn, respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text, in one of these shapes:\n\nTo search for more information:\n{\"thought\": \"<one short sentence>\", \"action\": \"search\", \"query\": \"<search text>\"}\n\nTo give a final answer:\n{\"thought\": \"<one short sentence>\", \"action\": \"answer\", \"answer\": \"<just the answer, or 'Insufficient evidence to determine this.' if you truly don't know>\", \"confidence\": \"high\"/\"low\", \"sources\": [\"<doc titles relied on>\"]}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _call_llm(messages: list[dict], max_retries: int = 2) -> dict:\n    api_key = os.environ.get(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY\")\n    if not api_key:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"OPENROUTER_API_KEY not set.\")\n    client = OpenAI(base_url=OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, api_key=api_key)\n\n    for attempt in range(max_retries + 1):\n        response = client.chat.completions.create(model=AGENT_MODEL, messages=messages)\n        raw = response.choices[0].message.content.strip()\n\n        if raw.startswith(\"```\"):\n            raw = raw.strip(\"`\")\n            if raw.startswith(\"json\"):\n                raw = raw[4:]\n            raw = raw.strip()\n\n        try:\n            return json.loads(raw)\n        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n            if attempt < max_retries:\n                # openrouter/free rotates across many models -- an occasional\n                # one ignores the JSON-only instruction or returns stray\n                # moderation text. Retrying usually lands on a different,\n                # better-behaved model rather than repeating the same failure.\n                continue\n            return {\"thought\": \"PARSE_ERROR\", \"action\": \"answer\",\n                     \"answer\": f\"[Could not parse model output after {max_retries+1} attempts: {raw[:300]}]\",\n                     \"confidence\": \"low\", \"sources\": []}\n\n\ndef _format_evidence(results: list[SearchResult]) -> str:\n    if not results:\n        return \"(no evidence gathered yet)\"\n    lines = []\n    for r in results:\n        via = \"+\".join(r.found_by)\n        lines.append(\n            f\"[{r.source_type}, reliability={r.reliability_prior}, found via {via}] \"\n            f\"{r.title}:\\n{r.text}\\n\"\n        )\n    return \"\\n---\\n\".join(lines)\n\n\ndef answer_question(question: str, verbose: bool = True) -> dict:\n    gathered: list[SearchResult] = []\n    seen_chunk_ids = set()\n    trace = []\n\n    for iteration in range(MAX_ITERATIONS):\n        user_message = (\n            f\"Question: {question}\\n\\n\"\n            f\"Evidence gathered so far:\\n{_format_evidence(gathered)}\"\n        )\n        messages = [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": SYSTEM_PROMPT},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user_message},\n        ]\n\n        decision = _call_llm(messages)\n        trace.append({\"iteration\": iteration, \"decision\": decision})\n\n        if verbose:\n            print(f\"\\n--- Iteration {iteration} ---\")\n            print(f\"Thought: {decision.get('thought', '')}\")\n            print(f\"Action: {decision.get('action', '')}\")\n\n        if decision.get(\"action\") == \"answer\":\n            draft_answer = decision.get(\"answer\", \"\")\n            if verbose:\n                print(f\"Draft answer: {draft_answer}\")\n                print(\"Checking for source conflicts...\")\n\n            conflict_check = check_for_conflicts(question, draft_answer, gathered)\n            trace.append({\"conflict_check\": conflict_check})\n\n            if verbose and conflict_check[\"conflict_found\"]:\n                print(f\"CONFLICT FOUND: {conflict_check['reasoning']}\")\n\n            return {\n                \"answer\": conflict_check[\"final_answer\"],\n                \"confidence\": decision.get(\"confidence\", \"unknown\"),\n                \"conflict_found\": conflict_check[\"conflict_found\"],\n                \"conflict_summary\": conflict_check.get(\"summary\", \"\"),\n                \"conflict_reasoning\": conflict_check[\"reasoning\"],\n                \"trace\": trace,\n            }\n\n        query = decision.get(\"query\", question)\n        if verbose:\n            print(f\"Searching: {query}\")\n        results = search_corpus(query, n_results=RESULTS_PER_SEARCH)\n\n        new_results = [r for r in results if r.chunk_id not in seen_chunk_ids]\n        for r in new_results:\n            seen_chunk_ids.add(r.chunk_id)\n        gathered.extend(new_results)\n\n    # Ran out of iterations -- be honest about it rather than forcing a guess.\n    if verbose:\n        print(\"\\n[Max iterations reached]\")\n    messages = [\n        {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": SYSTEM_PROMPT},\n        {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": (\n            f\"Question: {question}\\n\\nEvidence gathered so far:\\n{_format_evidence(gathered)}\\n\\n\"\n            \"You must give a final answer now. If the evidence is genuinely \"\n            \"insufficient, say so honestly rather than guessing.\"\n        )},\n    ]\n    decision = _call_llm(messages)\n    trace.append({\"iteration\": MAX_ITERATIONS, \"decision\": decision, \"forced\": True})\n\n    conflict_check = check_for_conflicts(question, decision.get(\"answer\", \"\"), gathered)\n    return {\n        \"answer\": conflict_check[\"final_answer\"],\n        \"confidence\": decision.get(\"confidence\", \"low\"),\n        \"conflict_found\": conflict_check[\"conflict_found\"],\n        \"conflict_summary\": conflict_check.get(\"summary\", \"\"),\n        \"conflict_reasoning\": conflict_check[\"reasoning\"],\n        \"trace\": trace,\n    }\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import sys\n    q = \" \".join(sys.argv[1:]) or \"In which year was the 'Gauntlet of Sorrowfell' actually forged?\"\n    result = answer_question(q)\n    print(f\"\\n=== FINAL ANSWER (confidence: {result['confidence']}) ===\")\n    print(result[\"answer\"])\n    if result[\"conflict_found\"]:\n        print(f\"\\n[Conflict resolved: {result['conflict_summary']}]\")\n", "filename": "/home/claude/ashen-agent/src/agent/agent_loop.py"}, "hidden_in_chat": null, "tool_origin": "first_party"}, {"start_timestamp": "2026-09-04T11:34:46.818470Z", "stop_timestamp": "2026-09-04T11:34:58.099674Z", "flags": null, "type": "tool_use", "id": "toolu_012kthwGLenrDAW75J7zydPA", "name": "create_file", "input": {"description": "Terminal theming: colors, spacing, pixel-block spinner animation, and warning suppression", "file_text": "\"\"\"\nTerminal output theming for the agent CLI. Ties visually to the same\ndig/mining metaphor as the web UI, so the CLI and UI feel like one\nconsistent product for your demo video, not two disconnected pieces.\n\nAlso silences a known harmless dependency warning (a logfire/pydantic\nplugin ImportError that fires on every run regardless of anything we do --\nit's a version mismatch inside chromadb's dependencies, not our code, and\ndoesn't affect functionality) so your terminal output stays clean.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nimport time\nimport threading\nimport warnings\n\nwarnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\")  # suppress the harmless logfire/pydantic warning\n\nfrom colorama import init as colorama_init, Fore, Style\ncolorama_init(autoreset=True)\n\n\ndef header(text: str):\n    bar = \"=\" * (len(text) + 4)\n    print(f\"\\n{Fore.CYAN}{bar}\")\n    print(f\"{Fore.CYAN}  {text}\")\n    print(f\"{Fore.CYAN}{bar}{Style.RESET_ALL}\")\n\n\ndef iteration_label(n: int):\n    print(f\"\\n{Fore.YELLOW}{Style.BRIGHT}--- LAYER {n} \" + \"-\" * 32 + Style.RESET_ALL)\n\n\ndef thought(text: str):\n    print(f\"{Fore.WHITE}  thought:{Style.RESET_ALL} {Style.DIM}{text}{Style.RESET_ALL}\")\n\n\ndef search_query(query: str):\n    print(f'{Fore.MAGENTA}  digging for: \"{query}\"{Style.RESET_ALL}')\n\n\ndef draft_answer(text: str):\n    print(f\"{Fore.WHITE}  draft answer:{Style.RESET_ALL} {text}\")\n\n\ndef answer(text: str, confidence: str):\n    color = Fore.GREEN if confidence == \"high\" else Fore.RED if confidence == \"low\" else Fore.YELLOW\n    width = 52\n    print(f\"\\n{Fore.CYAN}{'=' * width}\")\n    print(f\"{Fore.CYAN}  ANSWER   {color}[{confidence.upper()} CONFIDENCE]{Style.RESET_ALL}\")\n    print(f\"{Fore.CYAN}{'=' * width}{Style.RESET_ALL}\")\n    print(f\"  {Style.BRIGHT}{text}{Style.RESET_ALL}\\n\")\n\n\ndef conflict(summary: str):\n    print(f\"{Fore.RED}  \\u26a0 conflict resolved:{Style.RESET_ALL} {summary}\")\n\n\ndef info(text: str):\n    print(f\"{Fore.BLUE}{text}{Style.RESET_ALL}\")\n\n\nclass Spinner:\n    \"\"\"\n    Pixel-block spinner for the blocking waits (API calls). Runs in a\n    background thread so a multi-second network call doesn't just look\n    like a frozen terminal -- useful for a live demo recording especially.\n    Usage: with Spinner(\"digging for evidence...\"): <blocking call>\n    \"\"\"\n    FRAMES = [\"\\u2591\", \"\\u2592\", \"\\u2593\", \"\\u2588\", \"\\u2593\", \"\\u2592\"]\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str = \"working...\"):\n        self.message = message\n        self._running = False\n        self._thread = None\n\n    def _spin(self):\n        i = 0\n        while self._running:\n            frame = self.FRAMES[i % len(self.FRAMES)]\n            sys.stdout.write(f\"\\r{Fore.YELLOW}  {frame} {self.message}{Style.RESET_ALL}   \")\n            sys.stdout.flush()\n            time.sleep(0.15)\n            i += 1\n        sys.stdout.write(\"\\r\" + \" \" * (len(self.message) + 15) + \"\\r\")\n        sys.stdout.flush()\n\n    def __enter__(self):\n        self._running = True\n        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._spin, daemon=True)\n        self._thread.start()\n        return self\n\n    def __exit__(self, *args):\n        self._running = False\n        if self._thread:\n            self._thread.join(timeout=0.5)\n", "path": "/home/claude/ashen-agent/src/agent/cli_theme.py"}, "message": "Terminal theming: colors, spacing, pixel-block spinner animation, and warning suppression", "integration_name": "File Creation", "integration_icon_url": null, "tool_identifier": null, "icon_name": "file", "context": null, "display_content": {"type": "code_block", "language": "python", "code": "\"\"\"\nTerminal output theming for the agent CLI. for iteration in range(MAX_ITERATIONS):\n        user_message = (\n            f\"Question: {question}\\n\\n\"\n            f\"Evidence gathered so far:\\n{_format_evidence(gathered)}\"\n        )\n        messages = [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": SYSTEM_PROMPT},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user_message},\n        ]\n\n        if verbose:\n            ui.iteration_label(iteration)\n            with ui.Spinner(\"thinking...\"):\n                decision = _call_llm(messages)\n        else:\n            decision = _call_llm(messages)\n        trace.append({\"iteration\": iteration, \"decision\": decision})\n\n        if verbose:\n            ui.thought(decision.get(\"thought\", \"\"))\n\n        if decision.get(\"action\") == \"answer\":\n    with ui.Spinner(\"digging through the archive...\"):\n                results = search_corpus(query, n_results=RESULTS_PER_SEARCH)\n        else:\n            results = search_corpus(query, n_results=RESULTS_PER_SEARCH)\n\n        new_results = [r for r in results if r.chunk_id not in seen_chunk_ids]\n        for r in new_results:\n            seen_chunk_ids.add(r.chunk_id)\n        gathered.extend(new_results)\n\n    if verbose:\n        ui.info(\"\\n[Max iterations reached]\")\n    messages = [\n        {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": SYSTEM_PROMPT},\n        {\"role\":
