Operational Database vs Data Warehouse\"));\nconst oltpRows = [\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Aspect\", {shade:\"D9D9D9\", bold:true, width:3000}), cell(\"Operational Database\", {shade:\"D9D9D9\", bold:true, width:3500}), cell(\"Data Warehouse\", {shade:\"D9D9D9\", bold:true, width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Purpose\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Supports daily transactions\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Supports decision-making\", {width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Data\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Current data\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Historical data\", {width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Structure\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Highly normalized\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Often denormalized\", {width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Operations\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Frequent INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Mostly read-oriented\", {width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Optimization\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Optimized for transactions\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Optimized for analytical queries\", {width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Query pattern\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Many small queries\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Fewer, more complex queries\", {width:3500})] }),\n];\nchildren.push(new Table({ width: { size: USABLE_WIDTH, type: WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: [3000,3500,3500], rows: oltpRows }));\n\nchildren.push(h2(\"2. Data Integration Challenges\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Poor data quality \u2014 missing values, duplicates, inaccurate/inconsistent data.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Incompatible formats/structures \u2014 different schemas, databases, file formats, naming conventions.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Managing large data volumes \u2014 handling growing data efficiently and reliably.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Real-time data requirements \u2014 low-latency updates for time-sensitive applications.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Security and compliance \u2014 protecting sensitive data during movement/integration.\"));\n\nchildren.push(h2(\"3. The Seven Components of a Data Warehouse\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Data Sources \u2014 internal (sales, HR, finance) and external (APIs, partners) raw data providers.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"ETL/ELT (Data Integration & Ingestion) \u2014 Extract, Transform, Load: moves and prepares data.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Staging Area \u2014 temporary buffer where data is cleaned/standardized before entering the warehouse; also preserves raw copies for debugging.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Central Data Warehouse \u2014 single source of truth; integrated, historical, subject-oriented, non-volatile, read-optimized.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Data Marts \u2014 smaller, department-focused subsets for faster, simpler, more secure access.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Metadata \u2014 'data about data': table/column definitions, data types, source systems, transformation rules; enables lineage tracking and discovery.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"BI & Access Tools \u2014 presentation layer (dashboards, reports, visualization, OLAP, ad-hoc querying, predictive analytics); e.g., Power BI, Tableau.\"));\n\nchildren.push(h2(\"4. ETL Process (Recap)\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Extract \u2014 collect data from source systems.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Transform \u2014 clean, standardize, and integrate data.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Load \u2014 store the prepared data into the warehouse.\"));\n\nchildren.push(h2(\"5. Data Warehouse 3-Tier Architecture\"));\nconst tierRows = [\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Tier\", {shade:\"D9D9D9\", bold:true, width:2200}), cell(\"Role\", {shade:\"D9D9D9\", bold:true, width:5000}), cell(\"Contains\", {shade:\"D9D9D9\", bold:true, width:2800})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Bottom (Data Layer)\", {width:2200}), cell(\"Collects, cleans, transforms, and stores structured historical data\", {width:5000}), cell(\"Data sources, ETL, DW + Data Marts\", {width:2800})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Middle (OLAP Layer)\", {width:2200}), cell(\"Processing/logic bridge between storage and users\", {width:5000}), cell(\"OLAP server\", {width:2800})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Top (Presentation Layer)\", {width:2200}), cell(\"Users query, visualize, and analyse data\", {width:5000}), cell(\"Reporting/dashboard/analysis tools\", {width:2800})] }),\n];\nchildren.push(new Table({ width: { size: USABLE_WIDTH, type: WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: [2200,5000,2800], rows: tierRows }));\n\nchildren.push(h2(\"6. Data Warehouse vs Data Mart\"));\nconst dmRows = [\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Aspect\", {shade:\"D9D9D9\", bold:true, width:3000}), cell(\"Data Warehouse\", {shade:\"D9D9D9\", bold:true, width:3500}), cell(\"Data Mart\", {shade:\"D9D9D9\", bold:true, width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Scope\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Organization-wide\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Department/subject-specific\", {width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Data\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Integrated from multiple sources/departments\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Subset for one business area\", {width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Volume\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Large, historical\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Smaller, focused\", {width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Decision support\", {width:3000}), cell(\"Organization-wide decisions\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Departmental decisions\", {width:3500})] }),\n  new TableRow({ children: [cell(\"Complexity\", {width:3000}), cell(\"More complex to design/maintain\", {width:3500}), cell(\"Easier and faster to implement\", {width:3500})] }),\n];\nchildren.push(new Table({ width: { size: USABLE_WIDTH, type: WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: [3000,3500,3500], rows: dmRows }));\nchildren.push(p(\"\"));\nchildren.push(p(\"Key point: A Data Mart does NOT create new data \u2014 it's a simplified, faster-access subset drawn from the Enterprise Data Warehouse.\", { italics: true }));\n\nchildren.push(h2(\"7. Choosing EDW vs Data Mart \u2014 Decision Framework\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Need spans multiple departments / organization-wide strategic decision \u2192 Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW).\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Need is specific to one department (e.g., marketing campaigns only) \u2192 Data Mart.\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Why not query the full EDW directly? Data Marts are faster, simpler, and improve security by isolating sensitive departmental data.\"));\n\nchildren.push(h2(\"8. Common Data Quality Problems (from raw source data)\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Inconsistent ID formats (e.g., 'C101' vs '101').\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Inconsistent date formats (e.g., '01/05/25' vs '2025-05-01' vs 'May 2 2025').\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Inconsistent currency/number formatting (e.g., 'Rs. 12000' vs '12000').\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Duplicate records (same order appearing more than once).\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Inconsistent text casing (e.g., 'John Smith' vs 'JOHN SMITH', 'GALLE' vs 'Galle').\"));\nchildren.push(bullet(\"Fix: standardize IDs, dates, currency formats, and casing; remove duplicates \u2014 typically during the Transform step of ETL.\"));\n\nchildren.push(h2(\"9.
